scripts.title: auto clean
scripts.features:
Auto-clean puddles.
Note: Don't remove the wait(0.1) otherwise it will crash your game, you can change it to whatever you like however I don't know the lowest it can go before it crashes.

Extra Note: It won't remove the puddles it just gives the money for cleaning them.
scripts.script:
while true do wait(0.1)
local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Events.Remotes.Clean
Event:FireServer()
end
